title: Clarifying the meaning of a changed tomorrow
meaning: You can clarify ambiguous words as circumstances change and allow feelings to shift without replacing an actual answer with a guess.
text: The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in conversation changing with circumstances, sometimes very small ones. The Moon in energy supports the wish to understand ambiguity, separating actual words from assumptions about them. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions has a different role: your response changes as meaning becomes clearer. Amusing confusion can bring annoyance or relief without making the exchange pointless. What matters is hearing which answer applies to the present condition.

For example, you continue messaging after midnight and notice that “tomorrow” can now refer to different days. A promise to talk needs a date clarified rather than a guess about how each of you counts time. **Ambiguity is better clarified than completed on the other’s behalf**. At first the situation amuses; later, thinking you expected different things may feel unpleasant. You name a specific day and hear the answer. Clarity need not preserve the initial amusement or make a changed feeling another disagreement.

An unnecessary cycle begins if every shift of mood after clarifying the date is treated as a concealed revision of the promise. You check again, seeking an unchanging feeling instead of an answer. The Moon’s constructive attention to the unknown helps distinguish a real question from imagined continuation. You can keep a clear agreement while acknowledging that the experience of confusion is still changing; mood need not replace the calendar answer.
